newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels Bel-20 sets record close, helped by U.S..
newsitem.headline: Brussels Bel-20 sets record close, helped by U.S..

text.p: 1540 GMT - Bel-20 share index .BFX closed higher on the back of Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's encouraging comments on the U.S. economy, but dealers expected the bourse to consolidate in the coming days after the recent bull run.
* Bel-20 closed up 0.14 percent at 2,024.97 after touching a low of 2,013.48 in earlier trade.
* Main gainer, retailer GIB, jumped 3.64 to 1,565 francs after it said it was in talks to sell its Sarma unit.
* Main loser, non-ferrous metals producer Union Miniere, shed 1.76 percent, with dealers saying recent zinc and dollar prices were unable to support a higher share price.
